pairs.evidence: src/i18n/useTranslation.ts:393 This line is the production fix for the two-level crash on an unloaded section, but the test file written for that crash imports only the generated SECTION_SHAPES table, so reverting this line to the empty fallback leaves all five of its tests green (read, not run; incidental coverage from component tests on unseeded sections was not measured).

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/__tests__/unloadedSectionFallback.test.ts:32 The name states the crash fix, but the read is on a plain data object and never goes through the t proxy, getResolvedSection or shapeFor. Those names appear in tests only in a comment at routeSectionCoverage.test.ts:70, and src/test/setup.ts seeds the shared section the crash came from.

src/i18n/__tests__/chainStopReasons.parity.test.ts:23 The needle needs a full const declaration with type and value, which the doc comments in the Rust block do not contain. The block regex tolerates CRLF, and the same file declares a floor of 13 at line 31.

src/lib/__tests__/tauriInvoke.gitlabDeployTimeout.test.ts:32 The timeout claim is proved on fake timers by asserting the call is still pending past the budget, so machine load cannot change the result.
